source_reasoning.candidate_design: Map canonical paths to values plus direct-child counts, preventing parent deletion without scanning all descendants.

numeric_semantics: Python arbitrary-precision integers; JavaScript BigInt for grid counts, prime products, rational ratings and order quantities. Other input numeric fields are safe integers.
unicode_semantics: Passwords use Unicode code points; board and remaining identifier/string domains follow the explicit ASCII/lowercase contracts.

assumptions.basis: Public group preview only; no exact variant body

assumptions.text: Maintain canonical absolute paths with immutable root / holding root. create succeeds only for a missing non-root path with an existing parent. set updates existing non-root values. get returns a string or null. delete removes only existing non-root leaves. Operations return booleans except get.
